profile.headline: Software Engineer at Employee Navigator

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: C#, .NET, Vue.js, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure, GitLab, Docker, Octopus Deploy

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed both backend API services (.NET Core, C#) and frontend UI features (Angular, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML) to deliver story points according to project specifications, both greenfield and maintenance work

- Automated unit tests for all code committed into codebase using .NET and UI testing frameworks and SonarQube code quality analysis tools to achieve 100% code coverage

- Monitored and resolved personal code quality metrics to ensure net positive contribution points, a goal 92% debt-free commit rate, and zero test coverage or standards violations tech debt

- Converted existing AngularJS code to use Angular standards and conventions in support of application-wide migration to newest version of Angular

- Led the rebuild of an internal utility used by counselors/underwriters to compare side-by-side policy data retrieved in large XML blob formats from different points in time in support of triage and data remediation efforts, saving countless hours of manual data inspection for users via third-party apps

- Triaged production and non-production bugs by analyzing root causes via logs and stack traces and coding any requisite solutions in collaboration with business analyst team and according to business requirements

- Developed automated Splunk SQL reports for identifying production issues based on data inspected within log files

- Served as scrum master in agile scrum workflow, organizing and leading developers and analysts alike in team ceremonies and planning sessions in pursuit of sprint milestones

- Authored and published peer-reviewed reference docs to department-wide wiki site for new application developed by my scrum team

- Participated in strict, thorough code review practice, adding department-wide best practices and scrutiny in support of readability, good design, consistent formatting, and high code quality for the overall project

- Mentored new developers joining the team to help acclimate them to the team and our development environment

positions.title: Data Analyst & System Administrator - Financial Applications
positions.description:
- Developed custom queries/reports for operational and workflow-related data using SSMS/SSRS, for Finance client consumption in published report repository stored on internal-facing SharePoint site

- Provided day-to-day system administration for Microsoft Dynamics GP and integrations with third-party accounting systems

- Developed SQL scripts to perform mass database updates for Microsoft Dynamics GP databases in SQL Server

Tools:
SQL Server 2016
Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains)
Paramount WorkPlace
CCH Workpaper Manager

positions.title: Data Analyst - Enterprise Learning Technology
positions.description:
- Served as system administrator for SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System (LMS), with responsibilities encompassing access management, quarterly upgrade testing (QA and production), and BAU data/reporting consultation to provide clients with insights on learner tracking and knowledge retention via one-time reports or scheduling recurring report jobs

- Led automation of learning services intake process integration between Salesforce and SAP SuccessFactors LMS, including automation of metadata audit triggers for learning data, metadata validation approvals, and system-run cleanup according to predetermined audit cycles 

- Constructed initial data management/governance strategy for enterprise learning data, covering areas such as controlled data production, regular data quality assessments, and opportunities for automation to remove human error/intervention, where possible

- Managed comprehensive project effort to scrub aging data from LMS databases to improve search results within the system as learners seek out content/training for their development. Included enterprise-wide change management and communications, rigorous data analysis, coordination of mass database changes, and collaboration with learning consultants and other partners to ensure smooth cutover   

- Wrote/modified SQL queries using Plateau Report Designer (PRD) application in development of new, custom reporting for self-service report customers

- Wrote/modified HTML in custom intranet blogs using Jive (corporate social networking platform)

- Supported adoption of team-wide migration to agile scrum software development methodology, including daily standups, sprint grooming, planning, retro, demo ceremonies, managed within the JIRA platform

positions.title: QA Analyst - Human Capital Management Systems
positions.description:
Major project efforts: 

| SAP Support Pack upgrades | Global Performance Management System implementation | Web-based exit survey application launch and data storage/analysis | ATS enhancements | Consolidate HR approval workflows with web-based HR forms |

- Performed SAP HR configuration tasks, including table maintenance, transport management, and quality assurance

- Authored requirements documents, instructional/training materials and other technical specifications to add to team knowledge base/provide clear system delivery expectations before sign-off and development

- Served as key member of project and release teams, reviewing and providing input on business and system requirements, providing estimates on QA activities, status reporting on key QA metrics, approving product quality and sign-off for code migration to production, verifying production releases

- Developed/maintained baseline manual and automated (through Worksoft Certify tool) test plans/scripts for regression/unit/integration/user acceptance testing during planned projects and releases

- Managed ticket resolution process for issues identified during end-to-end testing phases for various production support efforts and planned projects, including issue analysis, re-test, development, communication with internal/external stakeholders and final resolution

- Provided testing support across corporate IT changes impacting HR applications (ex. regression testing HTTPS/database/Web browser/Portal/Java/Linux/etc. upgrades)

- Provided quality customer service to users with production support issues (troubleshooting, analysis, code fixes, agile development cycles, etc.)

- Served as primary SME for onboarding and provisioning issues/enhancements, ensuring that accurate HR data flows properly to affected downstream provisioning systems (issues including regional standardization, interface updates, duplicate profiling, missed provisioning, user error and incorrect data, GIS compliance, etc.)

positions.title: HRIS Analyst - Human Capital Management Systems
positions.description:
- Conducted full lifecycle User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and quality assurance for in-house product launches including Global Performance Management System (GPS), Employee Self-Service (ESS), Contractor Central talent management tool, Mobile Approval functionality, and new Exit Survey platform

- Performed day-to-day data administration of SAP HCM for global workforce of approximately 6,000 employees

- Documented and liaised production support issues related to all assigned business platforms, including HR Desktop, iCIMS Applicant Tracking System, IQ Navigator Vendor Management and Contingent Labor, Contractor Central talent management tool, WebMethods middleware, Global Performance Management System (GPS)

- Produced in-depth reports and supply data requests for business stakeholders (including HR business partners, talent management, learning & development, payroll, benefits, IT, travel, internal communications, work-life group)

- Advised business clients by providing statistical analysis of complex data sets and visualizations to help inform business decisions

- Initiated and executed requirements-gathering process with business stakeholders to ensure quality understanding and delivery of client’s needs in final product launch

- Supported data migration/integration/ongoing maintenance of merger and acquisition entities, including the Oprah Winfrey Network (OWN), HUB, Discovery Digital Networks, and 3Net

- Generated employee demographic data in response to industry benchmarking programs, including Working Mother 100 Best Companies and FORTUNE 100 Best Companies

- Led training sessions for business stakeholders seeking greater knowledge of available products/tools

- Conducted routine database audits for data cleansing/accuracy and optimization of reports utilizing said data

- Provided quality customer support to HR clients and general employee population requiring assistance

positions.title: Program Specialist - Global Work-Life & Inclusion
positions.description:
- Managed communication strategy, creative branding campaign, marketing/promotion, multimedia content production, client relations, corporate/network partnerships, events management and overall program administration for annual 16-week, company-wide health and well-being challenge serving 2500+ Discovery employees globally

- Directed strategy behind Discovery’s participation in employer of choice recognition programs, both writing/completing submission packages and managing employer/employee survey processes to improve employer brand and increase recruitment/retention capabilities (notable successes include recognition from: Working Mother Media, CableFAX, Alliance for Work-Life Progress, Best Companies Group, Universum, WICT, National Fatherhood Initiative, Work-Life Matters Magazine)

- Collaborated with human resources business partners to enhance work/life effectiveness for employee client groups through biennial employee engagement survey analysis and administration of diverse portfolio of U.S. work/life, wellness and timesaver programs, including concierge service, national dependent care, adoption assistance, onsite health/fitness/nutrition classes and services, etc.

- Provided corporate support and guidance for 7 independent, employee-led resource/affinity groups (women, LGBT, veteran, working parent, Asian, young career, and multicultural employees)

- Identified areas of improvement within current HR processes and practices with global action planning teams to develop formal recommendations regarding innovation in exit interview data analysis and global sabbatical policy and offerings

positions.title: Sponsorships/Marketing Intern - Discovery Education
positions.description:
- Developed promotional messaging strategy for Siemens the We Can Change the World Challenge, a national sustainability challenge that empowers students to develop and share environmental solutions in their local communities and the world

- Drafted customized written communication copy to be disseminated via Web-based information sharing tools to various Discovery Education audiences including administrators, teachers, parents, students etc.

- Provided project management and implementation support including data management, inventory management, customer support, communication with internal and external teams and vendors, and proofreading of program materials

positions.title: Communications Intern - Discovery Health/Planet Green/FitTV
positions.description:
- Maintained Web-based media materials and audio/video/image content for Discovery Health, Planet Green and Fit TV networks through regular company Press Web maintenance 

- Drafted press releases, media advisories and e-pitches to promote television series premieres, network-related news, brand-building, talent participation in events and other public appearances

- Utilized Cision Point, Lexis Nexis, Burrelles Luce and Google search software for media monitoring, media analysis, media list building and press release distribution purposes

positions.title: LifeWorks and Diversity Intern - Human Resources
positions.description:
- Managed demographic membership content for global employee affinity groups internally and through regular Web site and company Portal page maintenance 

- Supported global “Discovery Gets Packing” campaign, which provided 3500 backpacks to children from underprivileged elementary schools across the country

- Developed digital media implementation proposal about Generation Y Media Consumption to present to network general managers and senior-level executives across Discovery based on research conducted on current market trends and best practices in competing companies

- Contributed to early developmental meetings for Supplier Diversity initiative utilization to benefit small, minority- and women-owned vendors

positions.title: Project Specialist & Proposal Writer
positions.description:
- Developed formal response to separate government RFP for Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), Overseas Private Investment Corporation (OPIC) and US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)

- Researched best practices in operations described in solicitation and incumbent contract holder’s current operation

- Formulated strategic business, management, communications, etc. plans to submit to contractors for each respective proposal

positions.title: Senior Teaching Assistant - Department of Communication
positions.description:
Course title: COMM231 - News Writing and Reporting for Public Relations

- Prepare and present lesson plans and schedules in collaboration with instructor covering  topics such as news writing, event coverage, radio and TV copy, press releases, Web style-writing, pitches, social media, cover letters and resumes

- Assist instructor with development and maintenance of course ELMS/Blackboard site, including management of announcements, groups, assignments, postings, class discussion boards, etc. for assigned students, as directed by instructor

- Monitor and review student writing/reporting/editing submissions for application of principles, theories, format, techniques, specifications – including meaning, organization, interest, audience, grammar, punctuation, spelling and style errors – and ethical/legal issues involving writing/reporting/editing, honors and code violations, e.g. plagiarism, fabrication

positions.title: Administrative Assistant - Undergraduate Office of the Department of Mathematics
positions.description:
Department of Mathematics, Undergraduate Office; part of College of Computer, Mathematical & Physical Sciences

- Accommodated undergraduate students, professors and teaching assistants with their administrative needs by managing inter- and intradepartmental communication

- Provided information regarding advising, placement exams, transfer credits, directory information, tutoring requests, filing and lost and found

honors.title: Discovery STELLAR Award
honors.description:
Received for quality of work in SAP-wide Support Pack application project, spanning multiple testing phases that required regression testing for all SAP HR functionality. Primary responsibilities covered project management, UAT coordination, issue re-test and resolution, stakeholder communication, post-upgrade production support. 

From supervisor: "Jonathan, thank you for the excellent work you put into leading the support pack testing effort for the HR IT and business teams. In addition to your own testing, you coordinated among many teams, and kept everyone on target for completing on schedule. You had frequent communication and showed excellent customer service throughout the project. Thanks again!"

honors.title: Discovery STELLAR Award
honors.description:
Received for quality of work in long-term implementation project for HR stakeholders, including project management, quality assurance, and general support in absence of main project lead. 

From supervisor: "Jonathan, thanks very much for all the work you put into making the Global Mobility and LOA forms a success! These new forms are long-awaited additions to HR Desktop. I really appreciate your efforts in this project, in addition to your regular QA and support tasks. "

From peer: "Jonathan was really instrumental in mobility and LOA projects. He was phenomenal in developing test plan, the scripts and issues list in SharePoint and taken over the project responsibilities when I was away to make sure the project was moving along. He has raised his hand at every stage of the project and expanded his knowledge into areas he had never worked before."
